messages:
Sam: Okay obviously who is secretly DJing the office microwave? I swear it played 'Eye of the Tiger' when I hit popcorn :popcorn:
Priya: Not me. But if microwave has playlist, I'd like to queue 'Don't Stop Believin'' :joy:
Liam: @Sam that's probably me — I added 'Microwave Workout' to the speaker. Sorry not sorry :sweat_smile:
Aisha: Confession: I clap after my toast pops. It's a vibe.
DevBot: Reminder: kitchen speaker is on the communal device. Please keep volume < 60% between 2-4pm. —KitchenBot
Sam: @Liam you're banned from high-energy playlists before 9am. Also GIF of someone air-drumming :drum:
Priya: Quick poll: best microwave anthem? 1) Eye of the Tiger 2) Don't Stop Believin' 3) Uptown Funk 4) Silenced microwave = happiness
Liam: I vote 3. @Aisha we need synchronized toast clapping next Friday.
Aisha: Deal. I'll bring tiny pompoms :pom_poms:
Mia: Can we add 'microwave etiquette' to handbook? 2-line policy only.
Sam: Rule 1: If it smells like yesterday's lunch, YOU clean it. Rule 2: Dance permission depends on consensus.
Priya: :thumbsup: Agreed. Also kudos to @Mia for the plant watering last week :seedling:
Liam: :tada: @Mia legend.
Mia: Aw thanks! My plant is thriving. Also someone stole one of my spoons yesterday :eyes:
Sam: Mystery spoon heist thread when? :detective:
Priya: I have footage — it's a slow-motion cliffhanger of Ramen Steve taking a spoon.
Aisha: Spoon is probably living its best life in someone's desk drawer.
Mia: If spoon returns, it will be praised with a tiny one-liner inscription ceremony.
